name: smoke-e4
description: Pipeline test of E4 on a non-default liboqs build, never used for results: probe pass, then E4 for ML-DSA-44, ML-KEM-768, Falcon-512, SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f, HQC-1 and ECDSA P-256 (a classical control), tiny budgets (fast: 10 warm-up + 200 samples; slow: 1 s and at least 3 samples), 1 repetition. Start with run.sh --variant b2-portable or b3-native.
